dialogues.speaker: Mats
dialogues.text: All your general goods sold here at affordable prices, come and take a look!

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: Well, if it isn't the Honorary Knight! It's a pleasure to meet you!

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: I was doing business abroad previously, and I normally only come back during Weinlesefest. It's no surprise that we haven't met before.

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: If it's meant to be, I'm sure we'll meet again elsewhere!

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: As you can see, Weinlesefest is swarming with guests! I can make as much in one day here as I normally would in four or five!

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: I wish there were more lively festivals like this one!

response.speaker: Mats
response.text: See you, may we meet again!
